Class TensorParallelGroup

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.parallel.TensorParallelGroup
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class TensorParallelGroup extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Single-process tensor-parallel group: one ParallelState and CUDA device per TP rank, plus NCCL (or peer-copy fallback) collectives.

When NCCL is available, each rank calls allReduceSumInPlace(int, Tensor) on its own tensor without a host barrier gather. The communicator is retained for future pipeline-parallel send/recv on the same process group.

    • allReduceSumInPlace

      public void allReduceSumInPlace(int tpRank, Tensor local)
      In-place sum all-reduce. Every TP rank's worker thread must call this with its local tensor (same shape/dtype). No-op when tpSize == 1.
      Parameters:
      tpRank - calling rank.
      local - local tensor to reduce in place.

    • broadcast

      public void broadcast(Tensor[] locals, int root)
      Broadcasts locals[root] to every other slot. Caller must supply the full array (one tensor per rank) from a single coordinating thread, or use per-rank buffers that are already filled.
      Parameters:
      locals - one tensor per TP rank.
      root - source rank whose tensor is copied to the others.
